about.title: Sales Tax Calculator - Tax Amount, Total Price & Reverse Sales Tax
about.description: The Sales Tax Calculator helps you estimate the tax amount and final total from a pre-tax price, or work backward from a total price to find the pre-tax amount. It can be used by shoppers, small business owners, and online sellers to review common sales tax scenarios.

howTo.title: How to Use the Sales Tax Calculator

steps.title: Enter Price
steps.description: Input the item price (either pre-tax or total, depending on your goal).

steps.title: Set Tax Rate
steps.description: Enter the sales tax rate for your location (e.g., 7.5%).

steps.title: Choose Mode
steps.description: Select Add Tax (price → total) or Reverse Tax (total → pre-tax).

steps.title: Optional Adjustments
steps.description: Include discounts or shipping if they are taxable in your area.

steps.title: View Results
steps.description: See tax amount, pre-tax price, and final total broken down clearly.

tips: Local rates vary by state/city/county—confirm your jurisdiction's rate.
Some regions tax shipping or certain product categories—check local rules.
If you have a tax-exempt certificate, ensure the correct rate is applied (often 0%).

features.title: Add or Remove Tax
features.description: Compute total from pre-tax price or reverse-calculate pre-tax from total.

features.title: Flexible Rate Entry
features.description: Enter local tax percentages to compare results across locations.

features.title: Clear Breakdown
features.description: See item subtotal, tax amount, and final total in one view.

features.title: Discount & Shipping Options
features.description: Model common checkout scenarios and their taxability.

faq.a: It's the process of deriving the pre-tax price from a final total that already includes tax.
No. Tax rules vary widely; some states tax shipping, others don't. Check your local regulations.

faq.q: Can I use this for online sales?
faq.a: Yes. Enter the correct rate for the buyer's location to estimate checkout totals and tax amounts.

faq.q: Is this the same as income tax?
faq.a: No. Sales tax applies to purchases; income tax applies to earnings.

faq.q: Why don't my results match the store receipt exactly?
faq.a: Rounding rules, taxable item differences, and local surtaxes can cause small discrepancies. Use your local jurisdiction's rules as the final reference.
